panel_top_annotation.cross_definition: rho(displayed copy, the other reference copy) read from the same chr1 four rhos

panel_top_annotation.same_definition: rho(displayed copy, its matched reference copy) read from the same chr1 four rhos

roles: display / evaluation only; no fitting, no re-optimization, no new candidate
